cases.title: Card-not-present fraud
cases.summary: Six online card transactions in 40 minutes from a new device in another city. The customer disputes all six and says her card never left her wallet.

cases.title: VIP account takeover
cases.summary: A high-net-worth account had its registered phone number and email changed at 02:10, a new payee added at 02:14 and ₹12,75,000 transferred out at 02:31. Restricted to the Managers team.

documents.title: KYC: passport scan
documents.body: Customer: Priya Nair (C-101). Passport P8812349, issued Mumbai 2019, expires 2029. Date of birth 12-04-1990. Address: 14 Carter Road, Bandra West, Mumbai 400050, verified 11-02-2024. PEP screening: clear. Sanctions screening: clear.

documents.title: Card statement, Sep 2026
documents.body: Card ending 4417. Normal spend pattern: groceries and fuel in Mumbai, average ₹2,300 per transaction. On 27-09-2026 between 22:14 and 22:53 IST, six card-not-present transactions totalling ₹48,200 at electronics merchants (MCC 5732), all from device ID d-77f1 first seen that evening, IP geolocated to Kolkata.

documents.title: Customer email (forwarded)
documents.body:
From: priya.nair@mailbox.example
Subject: Disputed transactions on my card

Hello, I did not make any of the six online purchases on 27 September. I was at home in Mumbai all evening and my card was with me. Please block the card and refund me.

Regards, Priya

---

documents.title: KYC: restricted VIP file
documents.body: RESTRICTED. Customer C-205. Passport Z4471902, Aadhaar-linked mobile +91 98200 1xxxx, private-banking relationship since 2011. Registered address and nominee details on file. Access limited to the Managers team.

documents.title: Account activity, last 72h
documents.body: 02:10 registered mobile changed after an OTP to the old number was not answered. 02:11 registered email changed. 02:14 new payee 'RK Traders' added. 02:31 outbound IMPS ₹12,75,000 to RK Traders. Login device and IP never seen before on this account.

reports.title: Suspicious Activity Report
reports.body: Coordinated card-not-present fraud using compromised card credentials; recommend reporting merchant cluster and device d-77f1.
